# Linus Pauling Institute

> The Linus Pauling Institute at Oregon State University is a research center dedicated to micronutrient science, nutrition research, and health through evidence-based investigation of vitamins, minerals, and dietary supplements.

Located in Corvallis, Oregon, the institute conducts cutting-edge research in molecular nutrition and analytical chemistry while providing public health information through the Micronutrient Information Center. The institute combines basic research with translational services and public education on nutrition science and micronutrient health benefits.
